from sqlalchemy import text
import pandas as pd

# Calculate nearest-neighbor distance for each station
# Self-join to find distances between all pairs, then take minimum per station
query = text("""
WITH station_distances AS (
    SELECT 
        a1.id as station_id,
        a1.name_en as station_name,
        ST_Distance(a1.coordinate::geography, a2.coordinate::geography) as distance_m
    FROM air_quality_station a1
    JOIN air_quality_station a2 ON a1.id != a2.id
)
SELECT 
    station_id,
    station_name,
    MIN(distance_m) as nearest_neighbor_distance
FROM station_distances
GROUP BY station_id, station_name
ORDER BY nearest_neighbor_distance DESC
LIMIT 3
""")

from sqlalchemy import text
import pandas as pd

# Query to find the top 3 most isolated stations based on nearest-neighbor distance
query = text("""
WITH station_distances AS (
    SELECT 
        s1.id as station_id,
        s1.name_en as station_name,
        MIN(ST_Distance(s1.coordinate::geography, s2.coordinate::geography)) as nearest_neighbor_distance
    FROM air_quality_station s1
    JOIN air_quality_station s2 ON s1.id != s2.id
    GROUP BY s1.id, s1.name_en
)
SELECT station_name, nearest_neighbor_distance
FROM station_distances
ORDER BY nearest_neighbor_distance DESC
LIMIT 3
""")
